title: StrategyPackage runtime_config still contains event_signal capability flags, causing unified event-signal isolation test failure
description:
Expected: `backend/tests/test_unified_event_signal_schema.py::test_event_signal_is_not_consumed_by_trading_paths_in_current_phase` should pass, and current-phase trading-path code should not carry event_signal references unless they are explicitly exempted as non-consumption metadata.
Actual: `pytest backend/tests/test_unified_event_signal_schema.py -q -p no:cacheprovider` fails because `backend/services/strategy_package/runtime_config.py` contains `event_signal_enabled` and `event_signals`, and the test scanner counts those string literals as hits under the forbidden trading-path set.
required_verification: Run backend/tests/test_unified_event_signal_schema.py and prove event_signal is not referenced under current-phase trading paths.
Run backend/tests/strategy_package/test_runtime_config_contract.py and prove StrategyPackage runtime config does not expose event_signal capability fields.
Do not add a whitelist that hides a real StrategyPackage ownership leak unless Paper v2 explicitly owns a replacement capability.
closure_requirements: StrategyPackage runtime_config has no event_signal_enabled/event_signals/PlatformSignalCapability current-phase reserved fields.
Current event_signal isolation test passes without StrategyPackage exception.
If removed, runtime config hash/equivalence tests are updated to reflect the narrower contract.

events.note: This appears to be a new isolated failure, not a legacy cleanup regression.
Local bug registry search for strategy_package/event_signal returned no existing open issue.

If the intent is to keep event_signal capability metadata in StrategyPackage, the isolation test likely needs an explicit exemption for runtime_config; otherwise the capability flags should be moved out of current-phase trading-path code.
User confirmed #61 was input error and should be ignored. This bug remains in the queue as event_signal/StrategyPackage/Paper v2 ownership cleanup.
